jobs.title: Assistant Chef de Bar (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Assistant Chef de Bar (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Stellenantritt: 2026-09-01.

## This is what you move with us
• Supporting the Bar Manager in managing the team and organising the bar area (complaints management, staff management, staff training, shift planning)

• Ensuring exemplary guest service and smooth operations during shifts

• Preparation and presentation of drinks in compliance with high quality standards

• Ensuring cleanliness and tidiness in the bar area

• Carrying out orders and stock management for the bar

• Cashing up on the TCPOS cash register system & preparing the daily accounts

• Working closely with the Bar Manager and other departments to ensure seamless service

• Training and mentoring of bar staff to ensure excellent customer service

• Adhering to hotel policies and procedures in bar operations

## This is you
• Completed professional training

• At least 2 years of professional experience in the luxury hotel industry in the bar area

• Excellent knowledge of German and English, knowledge of other languages an advantage

• Extensive knowledge in the preparation of classic and modern cocktails and other drinks

• Knowledge of cigars and advising guests

• Organisational talent

• Stylish appearance, friendliness and charisma

• Ability to work in a team, flexibility and a pronounced guest service orientation

• We are looking for a long-term cooperation in this position.

## Benefits
At the Kulm Group, our people are the key to our success. That’s why we have a reputation for impeccable service. Our shared passion for high-end luxury, winter sports, haute cuisine and uncompromising service makes every stay unforgettable. When you work with us, we invest in you and provide you with the perfect platform to launch your career. All our team enjoy a wealth of amenities and perks, from comfortable accommodation and culinary delicacies, to our newly renovated staff lounge and free access to on-site fitness rooms. For us, providing the best employee experience is what sets our hospitality apart.
• Competitive      salary

• We continually strive to find new ways to reward our teams,      providing development opportunities, access to facilities and generous      discounts throughout the year.

• We offer discounted stays to family and friends at the Grand Hotel      Kronenhof or Kulm Hotel for the special rate of CHF 150 or CHF 200 a night      including breakfast in a single or a double room.

• Parents and partners receive 20% off on meals and drinks at Chesa      al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz or Le Pavillion in      Pontresina.

• 40% off on spa treatments, coiffeur and private purchase of goods      and services.

• Free use of the tennis courts at Kulm Hotel St Moritz.

• Discounts on tennis and golf lessons.

• Free use of the golf course with a licence or driving range.

• Day ski pass for CHF 45 per person for Corvatsch.

• Diavolezza/Lagalb and 1 Corvatsch Ski Night for free.

Apply now

## Assistant Restaurant Manager – Chesa al Parc (m/w/d)
Kulm Hotel

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:
This is what you move with usChesa al Parc is the culinary oasis for hotel guests, locals, and sports enthusiasts alike. Whether on our spacious sun terrace in summer, by the ice rink in winter, or inside our cozy restaurant, we serve Swiss specialties and international classics at the highest level. As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you are not only the operational backbone of the restaurant, but above all the face of the venue. You live and breathe hospitality and create memorable experiences our guests will cherish long after their visit.Your Responsabilities:Passion for Service: You manage your own station within our upscale à la carte service and anticipate the wishes of our discerning guests before they are even expressed.Leadership: In the absence of the Restaurant Manager, you confidently take charge of operations, coordinate daily service flow, and act as a reliable point of reference for our international team.Quality Assurance: You ensure our high service standards are consistently maintained and support smooth, harmonious cooperation between kitchen and service teams, both front and back of house.Training & Team Spirit: You assist with onboarding and training new team members while leading by example with a positive, hands-on attitude that motivates the entire team.
This is youQualifications: Completed training in hospitality, restaurant service, or a comparable qualification.Experience: At least 5 years of solid experience in upscale à la carte service. Initial leadership experience (e.g. as Shift Leader or Chef de Rang with responsibilities) is considered a strong advantage.Languages: Fluent German and good English skills are essential for daily guest interaction. Any additional language, especially Italian, is a valuable asset.Personality: You are highly resilient, remain calm and organized even during busy service periods, and maintain a clear overview at all times.Mindset: You have a natural, elegant, and warm presence. For you, hospitality is not just a job, but a true passion.
BenefitsAt Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

## Room Attendant / Zimmerdame / Roomboy (m/w/d)
Grand Hotel Kronenhof

Where alpine grandeur meets genuine warmth: For generations, the Grand Hotel Kronenhof has stood for timeless elegance, excellent service, and the highest standards at a 5-star superior level. Our philosophy combines uncompromising quality with an atmosphere of warmth and hospitality. To bring this high standard to life for our guests every day, we are looking for a personality who shares our passion for perfection.
This is what you move with usExcellence in Detail: Impeccable cleaning and maintenance of our luxurious rooms and suites in strict compliance with and implementation of LQA and Forbes standards.Perfect Guest Service: Conducting first-class morning and evening services (turndown) as well as cleaning public hotel areas and guest restrooms.Preservation of Value: Meticulous and professional care of fine materials, high-quality furniture, and decorative elements.Attentive & Discreet: Replenishing and monitoring the minibar.Genuine Warmth: Discreet, courteous, and warm service to perfectly safeguard the privacy of our discerning guests at all times.Start date: Immediate or by arrangement
This is youLuxury Segment Experience: Professional experience within the 5-star hospitality industry.Standard Expertise (Must-Have): You already possess profound knowledge and proven practical experience with Forbes and LQA quality benchmarks and implement them routinely.Eye for Detail: You have a keen sense of cleanliness, aesthetics, and detail.Personality: Absolute reliability, discretion, and a consistently well-groomed, professional appearance are second nature to you.Team Spirit & Warmth: You take genuine pleasure in service, possess a warm charisma, and enjoy working hand-in-hand within a passionate team.Communication: You have a good command of German or English; any additional language is a valuable asset.
BenefitsA work environment characterized by mutual respect, team spirit, and lived appreciation.The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of Switzerland’s leading luxury hotels.Attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, reasonably priced meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks and discounts.

Tutti i nostri team godono di una ricchezza di servizi e vantaggi, da sistemazioni confortevoli e prelibatezze culinarie, alla nostra nuova sala personale rinnovata e l'accesso gratuito alle sale fitness in loco. Offriamo soggiorni scontati a famiglia e amici al Grand Hotel Kronenhof o Kulm Hotel per la tariffa speciale di CHF 150 o CHF 200 a notte compresa la colazione in una camera singola o doppia. Genitori e partner ricevono il 20% di sconto sui pasti e bevande presso Chesa al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz o Le Pavillion a Pontresina. 40% di sconto sui trattamenti spa, coiffeur e acquisto privato di beni e servizi. Uso gratuito dei campi da tennis al Kulm Hotel St Moritz. Sconti sulle lezioni di tennis e golf. Uso gratuito del campo da golf con una licenza o un campo di guida. skipass giornaliero per CHF 45 a persona per Corvatsch. Diavolezza/Lagalb e 1 Corvatsch Ski Night gratis. Richiedi ora Assistant Restaurant Manager – Chesa al Parc (m/w/d) Kulm Hotel Persone a 1800m sul livello del mare stanno modellando il Luxury Mountain Travel. La nostra comunità dinamica e internazionale offre ai nostri ospiti smart Luxury per un'esperienza di vacanza inimitabile. Come membro del gruppo Luxury Kulm fai parte della chiave del nostro successo. Insieme, rendiamo ogni soggiorno profondamente ispiratore, unico e distintivo. E come tale, abbracciamo la nostra cultura: lusso sobrio, ispirazione e un'esperienza di vita. Insieme, facciamo in modo che accada. Questa è la tua occasione per essere un membro della nostra cultura di modellazione: Questo è quello che ti muovi con noiChesa al Parc è l'oasi culinaria per gli ospiti dell'hotel, la gente del posto e gli appassionati di sport. Sia sulla nostra spaziosa terrazza solarium in estate, sulla pista di pattinaggio in inverno, o all'interno del nostro accogliente ristorante, serviamo specialità svizzere e classici internazionali al massimo livello. Come Assistant Restaurant Manager, non siete solo la spina dorsale operativa del ristorante, ma soprattutto la faccia della sede. Vivi e respiri l'ospitalità e crei esperienze memorabili che i nostri ospiti apprezzeranno molto dopo la loro visita. Le tue Responsabilità:Passione per il Servizio: gestisci la tua stazione all'interno del nostro servizio à la carte e anticipa i desideri dei nostri ospiti esigenti prima che siano espressi. Leadership: In assenza del Restaurant Manager, si assume con fiducia le operazioni, coordina il flusso di servizio giornaliero e funge da punto di riferimento affidabile per il nostro team internazionale. Garanzia di qualità: Garantisci che i nostri elevati standard di servizio sono costantemente mantenuti e supportano la cooperazione liscia e armoniosa tra i team di cucina e di servizio, sia davanti che dietro casa. Training & Team Spirit: Si assiste a salire a bordo e formare nuovi membri del team, guidando per esempio con un atteggiamento positivo e pratico che motiva l'intero team. Questa è la vostra qualità: Formazione completa in ospitalità, servizio ristorante, o una qualifica paragonabile. Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni di solida esperienza nel servizio à la carte. L'esperienza iniziale di leadership (ad esempio, come Shift Leader o Chef de Rang con responsabilità) è considerata un forte vantaggio. Lingue: Tedesco fluido e buone competenze in inglese sono essenziali per l'interazione quotidiana degli ospiti. Qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva, soprattutto italiana, è un bene prezioso. Personalità: Lei è altamente resiliente, rimanere calmo e organizzato anche durante i periodi di servizio impegnati, e mantenere una chiara panoramica in ogni momento. Mindset: Hai una presenza naturale, elegante e calda. Per te, l'ospitalità non è solo un lavoro, ma una vera passione. BenefitsAt Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi. • Professional background: You have completed vocational training in hospitality or a commercial field – ideally within luxury hospitality – and offer several years of relevant experience.

jobs.description:
Assistant Restaurant Manager – Chesa al Parc (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Stellenantritt: 2026-06-10.

## This is what you move with us
Chesa al Parc is the culinary oasis for hotel guests, locals, and sports enthusiasts alike. Whether on our spacious sun terrace in summer, by the ice rink in winter, or inside our cozy restaurant, we serve Swiss specialties and international classics at the highest level. As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you are not only the operational backbone of the restaurant, but above all the face of the venue. You live and breathe hospitality and create memorable experiences our guests will cherish long after their visit.Your Responsabilities:
• Passion for Service: You manage your own station within our upscale à la carte service and anticipate the wishes of our discerning guests before they are even expressed.

• Leadership: In the absence of the Restaurant Manager, you confidently take charge of operations, coordinate daily service flow, and act as a reliable point of reference for our international team.

• Quality Assurance: You ensure our high service standards are consistently maintained and support smooth, harmonious cooperation between kitchen and service teams, both front and back of house.

• Training & Team Spirit: You assist with onboarding and training new team members while leading by example with a positive, hands-on attitude that motivates the entire team.

## This is you
• Qualifications: Completed training in hospitality, restaurant service, or a comparable qualification.

• Experience: At least 5 years of solid experience in upscale à la carte service. Initial leadership experience (e.g. as Shift Leader or Chef de Rang with responsibilities) is considered a strong advantage.

• Languages: Fluent German and good English skills are essential for daily guest interaction. Any additional language, especially Italian, is a valuable asset.

• Personality: You are highly resilient, remain calm and organized even during busy service periods, and maintain a clear overview at all times.

• Mindset: You have a natural, elegant, and warm presence. For you, hospitality is not just a job, but a true passion.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

100%

Working in direct collaboration with the General Management, you bear overall responsibility for the Rooms Division and act as the driving force for quality and innovation:

• Commercial Mindset: In close coordination with Revenue Management, Sales, and Marketing, you optimize occupancy and ADR. You are responsible for budget planning, forecasting, and cost control (labor and operating expenses) with a focus on maximum profitability.

• Process Pioneer: You drive digital transformation and optimize internal SOPs to minimize friction and maximize the time dedicated to the guest.

• Training: Constant training and continuous development of the teams.

• Host Mentality: You maintain a strong presence in the lobby, cultivate relationships with our discerning regular guests, and master complex complaint management with composure and charm.

## This is you
We are seeking an established leadership personality who thrives on complexity and views excellence as a way of life.
• Experience: You have completed a degree or vocational training in luxury hospitality and possess several years of leadership experience in a comparable position within the international 5-star hotel industry.

• Linguistic Proficiency: You are business fluent in both German and English. Due to our location and team structure, Italian is considered a very significant advantage.

• Coach & Mentor: You lead through inspiration rather than hierarchy. You find joy in developing talent and coaching fellow managers.

• Digital Affinity: You are confident in using modern PMS systems and have a passion for co-designing efficient digital processes.

• Demeanor: You embody the values of the Kulm Hotel—discreet, precise, resilient, and always acting as a natural role model.
Why the Kulm Group?
• Creative Freedom: A position of absolute trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our properties, both humanly and professionally.

• Appreciation: An environment that values your experience in people management and gives you the space to establish modern, world-class leadership approaches.

• Exclusivity: Working at one of the world’s premier addresses within a team that places a high value on cohesion and mutual support.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

100%

In addition, you serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for guests staying in our exclusive residences. Leadership Skills: You are a leader who inspires through expertise and personal integrity. You know how to structure processes without compromising the flexibility required in a luxury hospitality environment.   Training & Development: You are passionate about continuously developing and empowering your team.   Digital Affinity: Confident user of computers and standard business software.   Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English. As a large portion of our team speaks Italian or Portuguese, Italian language skills are a significant advantage in your daily work.   Analytical Thinking: You enjoy working with figures, budgeting, forecasting, and modern hotel management systems. Opportunity to Shape the Future: A position of great trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of our properties, both operationally and culturally.   Recognition & Appreciation: An environment that values your expertise in people management and provides the freedom to establish modern leadership practices at a world-class level.   Exclusivity: Work at one of the world’s most prestigious hospitality destinations, alongside a team that places great importance on collaboration and mutual support.

Housekeeping Director (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Unbefristet / Permanent. Stellenantritt: 2026-08-01.

## This is what you move with us
At Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, Housekeeping is the heart of our property. With 150 rooms and suites, 30 residences, staff accommodations, and magnificent public areas, we set benchmarks in alpine luxury hospitality. As Housekeeping Director, you are the strategic leader behind this demanding operation. You will lead the department with foresight, composure, and an uncompromising eye for aesthetics. In this key position, you will report directly to the EAM Rooms Division and be responsible for the Housekeeping department (approximately 50–80 employees):
•  Department Leadership & Vision: You oversee the overall aesthetics of the rooms division and ensure that Forbes, LQA, and our internal quality standards are not only achieved but consistently lived as benchmarks of excellence.

•  Management Leadership: You lead and coach the Housekeeping Manager and Laundry Manager, who oversee daily operations. Together, you continuously develop and enhance the departments.

•  Staff Accommodation & Residence Management: You hold overall responsibility for the administration and quality standards of staff housing and employee rooms. In addition, you serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for guests staying in our exclusive residences.

•  Financial Management: You are responsible for the department’s budget, monitor labor costs (P&L), coordinate purchasing activities, and plan investments for renovations and new acquisitions.

•  Cross-Department Collaboration: You work closely with Engineering, Laundry, and Front Office teams to ensure a seamless guest journey.

•  Sustainability & Innovation: You implement environmentally sustainable cleaning concepts and drive the digitalization of housekeeping processes.

•  Talent Development: You are responsible for long-term workforce planning, recruiting key positions, and developing talent within your large, international team.

## This is you
You are an accomplished professional who has already demonstrated the ability to successfully and efficiently lead large teams in the luxury hospitality industry.
•  Experience: You have a long-standing career in Housekeeping within five-star hotels and have successfully held a senior leadership position (e.g., Executive Housekeeper or Director) in properties of comparable size.

•  Leadership Skills: You are a leader who inspires through expertise and personal integrity. You know how to structure processes without compromising the flexibility required in a luxury hospitality environment.

•  Training & Development: You are passionate about continuously developing and empowering your team.

•  Digital Affinity: Confident user of computers and standard business software.

•  Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English. As a large portion of our team speaks Italian or Portuguese, Italian language skills are a significant advantage in your daily work.

•  Analytical Thinking: You enjoy working with figures, budgeting, forecasting, and modern hotel management systems.

•  Personality: You are characterized by professionalism, discretion, and exceptionally high aesthetic standards. Even during peak season, you maintain calmness, focus, and a clear overview.
  Why Kulm Hotel?
•  Opportunity to Shape the Future: A position of great trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of our properties, both operationally and culturally.

•  Recognition & Appreciation: An environment that values your expertise in people management and provides the freedom to establish modern leadership practices at a world-class level.

•  Exclusivity: Work at one of the world’s most prestigious hospitality destinations, alongside a team that places great importance on collaboration and mutual support.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

• Languages: You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of German, Italian, Portuguese, or any additional language is considered a strong asset.

• Organizational Skills: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Resilience: You are physically fit, enjoy being hands-on, and appreciate the balance between operational responsibilities and administrative tasks.

• Personality: You possess a strong eye for detail, a proactive mindset, a positive attitude, and the ability to motivate and lead by example.

• Flexibility: You are willing to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays, according to operational needs.

At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

• Providing high-quality facials, manicures and pedicures (including gel colour polish with OPI) at Swiss deluxe level.

• Performing classic and signature massages – ideally including Lomi Lomi, Thai or hot stone.

• Helping to create an unforgettable spa experience: providing personal advice to our guests, actively selling exclusive products and treatments.

jobs.description:
Reservations Agent  (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Unbefristet / Permanent. Stellenantritt: 2026-06-01.

## This is what you move with us
• Competently handle reservations for individual and group guests as the first point of contact, ensuring the highest level of professionalism and proactive attention to detail

•  Maintain and update guest databases with the utmost accuracy, contributing significantly to guest satisfaction and loyalty

•  Address and resolve guest complaints promptly and with sensitivity, always finding the most suitable solution in a discreet and efficient manner

•  Manage multichannel communication, responding to all incoming enquiries by phone and email

•  Coordinate with other departments to ensure optimal alignment between room and event occupancy and our F&B and Spa offerings

•  Support the Reservations Manager with administrative tasks, ensure adherence to our high standards, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our products

## This is you
• Charisma and friendliness with a natural warmth and refined manners, combined with a keen sense for the needs of discerning guests

•  Team spirit and flexibility, with excellent communication skills and the ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment

•  Experience in luxury hospitality, with completed vocational training and at least two years of experience in a 5-star hotel in Front Office or Reservations

•  Strong language skills in German and English (written and spoken); additional languages such as Italian are an advantage

•  Technical proficiency in Opera Cloud, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as experience managing online booking channels

•  Exceptional organisational skills and customer focus, ensuring precise planning, discreet guest relations, and outstanding service delivery

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Apply now

## Assistant Front Office Manager (m/w/d)
Kulm Hotel

100%

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:
This is what you move with usLeadership & Partnership: You confidently represent the Front Office Manager and work together to ensure seamless operations at the highest level.The Guest Journey: From a warm welcome to a smooth check-out, you ensure our guests' stay is truly unforgettable.Knowledge Sharing: You contribute your expertise through staff training and performance reviews, while maintaining clear and professional communication with all other departments.Point of Contact: You serve as the primary contact for our guests—competent, proactive, and solution-oriented at all times.Administrative Excellence: You are responsible for statistics and month-end closings, ensuring strict adherence to LHW, Forbes, and Kulm standards.Guest Experience: With your profound knowledge of the hotel and the local region, you inspire our guests and guarantee a unique, world-class experience.
This is youEducation & Experience: You hold a degree in hospitality or business, with at least 3 years of experience in the 5-star luxury hotel segment.Leadership Skills: You possess proven leadership experience and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional service.Personality: You have a sophisticated appearance, a true host’s heart, and find joy in personal guest interaction.Languages: Must-have: Native or bilingual fluency in German and excellent English. Additional languages are a distinct advantage.Start Date: Available from June; we offer both 10-month seasonal or permanent year-round positions.
BenefitsAt Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Grand Hotel Kronenhof

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. ## Room Attendant / Zimmerdame / Roomboy (m/w/d)
Grand Hotel Kronenhof

Where alpine grandeur meets genuine warmth: For generations, the Grand Hotel Kronenhof has stood for timeless elegance, excellent service, and the highest standards at a 5-star superior level. Our philosophy combines uncompromising quality with an atmosphere of warmth and hospitality. To bring this high standard to life for our guests every day, we are looking for a personality who shares our passion for perfection.
This is what you move with usExcellence in Detail: Impeccable cleaning and maintenance of our luxurious rooms and suites in strict compliance with and implementation of LQA and Forbes standards.Perfect Guest Service: Conducting first-class morning and evening services (turndown) as well as cleaning public hotel areas and guest restrooms.Preservation of Value: Meticulous and professional care of fine materials, high-quality furniture, and decorative elements.Attentive & Discreet: Replenishing and monitoring the minibar.Genuine Warmth: Discreet, courteous, and warm service to perfectly safeguard the privacy of our discerning guests at all times.Start date: Immediate or by arrangement
This is youLuxury Segment Experience: Professional experience within the 5-star hospitality industry.Standard Expertise (Must-Have): You already possess profound knowledge and proven practical experience with Forbes and LQA quality benchmarks and implement them routinely.Eye for Detail: You have a keen sense of cleanliness, aesthetics, and detail.Personality: Absolute reliability, discretion, and a consistently well-groomed, professional appearance are second nature to you.Team Spirit & Warmth: You take genuine pleasure in service, possess a warm charisma, and enjoy working hand-in-hand within a passionate team.Communication: You have a good command of German or English; any additional language is a valuable asset.
BenefitsA work environment characterized by mutual respect, team spirit, and lived appreciation.The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of Switzerland’s leading luxury hotels.Attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, reasonably priced meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks and discounts.

As Housekeeping Director, you are the strategic leader behind this demanding operation. You will lead the department with foresight, composure, and an uncompromising eye for aesthetics. In this key position, you will report directly to the EAM Rooms Division and be responsible for the Housekeeping department (approximately 50–80 employees): Department Leadership & Vision: You oversee the overall aesthetics of the rooms division and ensure that Forbes, LQA, and our internal quality standards are not only achieved but consistently lived as benchmarks of excellence. jobs.description:
Room Attendant / Zimmerdame / Roomboy (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Stellenantritt: 2026-07-01.

## This is what you move with us
• Excellence in Detail: Impeccable cleaning and maintenance of our luxurious rooms and suites in strict compliance with and implementation of LQA and Forbes standards.

• Perfect Guest Service: Conducting first-class morning and evening services (turndown) as well as cleaning public hotel areas and guest restrooms.

• Preservation of Value: Meticulous and professional care of fine materials, high-quality furniture, and decorative elements.

• Attentive & Discreet: Replenishing and monitoring the minibar.

• Genuine Warmth: Discreet, courteous, and warm service to perfectly safeguard the privacy of our discerning guests at all times.

• Start date: Immediate or by arrangement

## This is you
• Luxury Segment Experience: Professional experience within the 5-star hospitality industry.

• Standard Expertise (Must-Have): You already possess profound knowledge and proven practical experience with Forbes and LQA quality benchmarks and implement them routinely.

• Eye for Detail: You have a keen sense of cleanliness, aesthetics, and detail.

• Personality: Absolute reliability, discretion, and a consistently well-groomed, professional appearance are second nature to you.

• Team Spirit & Warmth: You take genuine pleasure in service, possess a warm charisma, and enjoy working hand-in-hand within a passionate team.

• Communication: You have a good command of German or English; any additional language is a valuable asset.

## Benefits
• A work environment characterized by mutual respect, team spirit, and lived appreciation.

• The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of Switzerland’s leading luxury hotels.

• Attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, reasonably priced meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks and discounts.

Apply now

## Housekeeping Supervisor  (m/w/d)
Grand Hotel Kronenhof

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:
This is what you move with usQuality Assurance: You conduct daily inspections of guest rooms, suites, and public areas, ensuring that our high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service are consistently maintained.Operational Support: You actively support the Housekeeping team in daily operations and help ensure smooth workflows across all assigned areas.Team Coordination: You organize daily housekeeping activities, coordinate room assignments, and ensure that priorities are executed efficiently and on time.Training & Onboarding: You assist in the onboarding of new team members and provide ongoing on-the-job training and coaching to maintain and continuously improve service quality.Control & Documentation: You report maintenance issues, oversee Lost & Found procedures, and ensure compliance with internal policies as well as health, safety, and hygiene standards.Interdepartmental Communication: You work closely with the Front Office, Engineering, and Laundry teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience and ensure efficient communication between departments.
This is youYou understand that outstanding housekeeping is often the art of the unseen – everything is impeccable, allowing guests to enjoy a flawless and comfortable stay.Experience: You have a professional background in hospitality and ideally previous experience as a Floor Supervisor, Housekeeping Supervisor, or in a similar role within a luxury hotel environment.Languages: You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of German, Italian, Portuguese, or any additional language is considered a strong asset.Organizational Skills: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.Resilience: You are physically fit, enjoy being hands-on, and appreciate the balance between operational responsibilities and administrative tasks.Personality: You possess a strong eye for detail, a proactive mindset, a positive attitude, and the ability to motivate and lead by example.Flexibility: You are willing to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays, according to operational needs.
BenefitsAt Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

## Assistant Chef de Bar (m/w/d)
Grand Hotel Kronenhof

100%

This is what you move with usSupporting the Bar Manager in managing the team and organising the bar area (complaints management, staff management, staff training, shift planning)Ensuring exemplary guest service and smooth operations during shiftsPreparation and presentation of drinks in compliance with high quality standardsEnsuring cleanliness and tidiness in the bar areaCarrying out orders and stock management for the barCashing up on the TCPOS cash register system & preparing the daily accounts Working closely with the Bar Manager and other departments to ensure seamless serviceTraining and mentoring of bar staff to ensure excellent customer serviceAdhering to hotel policies and procedures in bar operations
This is youCompleted professional training At least 2 years of professional experience in the luxury hotel industry in the bar areaExcellent knowledge of German and English, knowledge of other languages an advantageExtensive knowledge in the preparation of classic and modern cocktails and other drinksKnowledge of cigars and advising guestsOrganisational talent Stylish appearance, friendliness and charismaAbility to work in a team, flexibility and a pronounced guest service orientationWe are looking for a long-term cooperation in this position.
BenefitsAt the Kulm Group, our people are the key to our success. That’s why we have a reputation for impeccable service. Our shared passion for high-end luxury, winter sports, haute cuisine and uncompromising service makes every stay unforgettable. When you work with us, we invest in you and provide you with the perfect platform to launch your career. All our team enjoy a wealth of amenities and perks, from comfortable accommodation and culinary delicacies, to our newly renovated staff lounge and free access to on-site fitness rooms. For us, providing the best employee experience is what sets our hospitality apart.    Competitive      salaryWe continually strive to find new ways to reward our teams,      providing development opportunities, access to facilities and generous      discounts throughout the year. We offer discounted stays to family and friends at the Grand Hotel      Kronenhof or Kulm Hotel for the special rate of CHF 150 or CHF 200 a night      including breakfast in a single or a double room.Parents and partners receive 20% off on meals and drinks at Chesa      al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz or Le Pavillion in      Pontresina.40% off on spa treatments, coiffeur and private purchase of goods      and services.Free use of the tennis courts at Kulm Hotel St Moritz.Discounts on tennis and golf lessons.Free use of the golf course with a licence or driving range.Day ski pass for CHF 45 per person for Corvatsch.Diavolezza/Lagalb and 1 Corvatsch Ski Night for free.

In camera / Zimmerdame / Roomboy (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Grigioni). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Stellenantritt: 2026-07-01. Eccellenza nel dettaglio: pulizia e manutenzione impeccabile delle nostre lussuose camere e suite nel rispetto e nell'attuazione degli standard LQA e Forbes.
• Servizio Ospite perfetto: Condurre servizi di prima classe mattina e serale (turndown) così come la pulizia delle aree alberghiere pubbliche e dei bagni degli ospiti.
• Conservazione del valore: Meticolosa e cura professionale di materiali pregiati, mobili di alta qualità e elementi decorativi.
• Attentive & Discreet: Rifornire e monitorare il minibar.
• Genuine Warmth: Discreto, cortese, e servizio caldo per garantire perfettamente la privacy dei nostri ospiti esigenti in ogni momento.
• Data di inizio: Immediato o arrangiamento Questo sei tu
• Esperienza di Segmento di Lusso: Esperienza professionale nel settore dell'ospitalità a 5 stelle.
• Standard Expertise (Must-Have): Tu già possiedi profonda conoscenza e comprovata esperienza pratica con i benchmark di qualità Forbes e LQA e implementali di routine.
• Occhio per dettaglio: si ha un forte senso di pulizia, estetica e dettaglio.
• Personalità: assoluta affidabilità, discrezione e un aspetto professionale costantemente ben curato sono di seconda natura per voi.
• Team Spirit & Warmth: Si prende un vero piacere in servizio, possiede un carisma caldo, e godere di lavorare di mano in mano in un team appassionato.
• Comunicazione: Hai un buon comando di tedesco o inglese; qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un bene prezioso. Vantaggi
• Un ambiente di lavoro caratterizzato da rispetto reciproco, spirito di squadra e apprezzamento vissuto.
• La possibilità di avere un impatto significativo in uno dei principali hotel di lusso della Svizzera.
• Opportunità di sviluppo attraente, alloggio confortevole, pasti a prezzi ragionevoli nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi e sconti. Il Grand Hotel Kronenhof Le persone a 1800 metri sul livello del mare stanno modellando il Luxury Mountain Travel. La nostra comunità dinamica e internazionale offre ai nostri ospiti smart Luxury per un'esperienza di vacanza inimitabile. Come membro del gruppo Luxury Kulm fai parte della chiave del nostro successo. Insieme, rendiamo ogni soggiorno profondamente ispiratore, unico e distintivo. E come tale, abbracciamo la nostra cultura: lusso sobrio, ispirazione e un'esperienza di vita. Insieme, facciamo in modo che accada. Questa è la tua occasione per essere un membro della nostra cultura di modellazione: Questo è ciò che ti muovi con noiQuality Assurance: Conduci ispezioni giornaliere di camere, suite e aree pubbliche, assicurando che i nostri elevati standard di pulizia, presentazione e servizio sono costantemente mantenuti. Supporto Operativo: Supporti attivamente il team di pulizia nelle operazioni quotidiane e aiuta a garantire flussi di lavoro fluidi in tutte le aree assegnate. Coordinamento del team: Si organizzano attività di pulizia quotidiana, coordinare le assegnazioni delle camere, e garantire che le priorità siano eseguite in modo efficiente e puntuale. Formazione & Onboarding: assisti all'imbarco di nuovi membri del team e fornisci un continuo training on-the-job e coaching per mantenere e migliorare continuamente la qualità del servizio. Controllo e documentazione: Si segnalano problemi di manutenzione, supervisionare le procedure Lost & Found e garantire il rispetto delle politiche interne, nonché gli standard di salute, sicurezza e igiene. Interdepartmental Communication: Lavorate a stretto contatto con i team di Front Office, Engineering e Lavanderia per offrire un'esperienza eccezionale agli ospiti e garantire una comunicazione efficiente tra i dipartimenti. Questo è Lei capisce che la pulizia eccezionale è spesso l'arte dell'invisibile – tutto è impeccabile, permettendo agli ospiti di godere di un soggiorno impeccabile e confortevole. Esperienza: Hai uno sfondo professionale nell'ospitalità e l'esperienza idealmente precedente come supervisore del pavimento, supervisore della pulizia, o in un ruolo simile in un ambiente di hotel di lusso. Lingue: Lei comunica fluentemente in inglese. La conoscenza di tedesco, italiano, portoghese o di qualsiasi altra lingua è considerata un bene forte. Competenze organizzative: Siete altamente organizzati, orientati ai dettagli, e in grado di priorizzare in modo efficace in un ambiente veloce. Resilienza: Tu sei fisicamente in forma, goditi di essere pratico e apprezzi l'equilibrio tra responsabilità operative e compiti amministrativi. Personalità: Possiedi un occhio forte per i dettagli, una mentalità proattiva, un atteggiamento positivo, e la capacità di motivare e guidare per esempio. Flessibilità: Lei è disposto a lavorare turni, compresi i fine settimana e i giorni festivi, secondo le esigenze operative. BenefitsAt Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi. Assistente Chef de Bar (m/w/d) Grand Hotel Kronenhof 100% Questo è ciò che ti muovi con noiSostegno al Bar Manager nella gestione del team e nell'organizzazione dell'area bar (gestione reclami, gestione del personale, formazione del personale, pianificazione dei turni) Garantire un servizio clienti esemplare e operazioni lisce durante i turniPreparazione e presentazione di bevande in conformità con gli standard di alta qualità Garantire la pulizia e la tidienza nell'area barAccettare ordini e la gestione delle scorte per la barraCashing up sul sistema di cassa TCPOS & preparare i conti giornalieri Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Bar Manager e altri dipartimenti per garantire un servizio senza soluzione di continuitàTraining e mentore del personale a barre per garantire eccellenti politiche di servizio clienti Questa è la formazione professionale completa Almeno 2 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore alberghiero di lusso nell'area bar Conoscenza eccellente di tedesco e inglese, conoscenza di altre lingue un vantaggioExtensive conoscenza nella preparazione di cocktail classici e moderni e altre bevandeKnowledge di sigari e consigliare gli ospitiOrganizational talenti Elegante apparenza, cordialità e carisma Capacità di lavorare in un team, flessibilità e un pronunciato orientamento di servizio degli ospiti Stiamo cercando una cooperazione a lungo termine in questa posizione. VantaggiAl Gruppo Kulm, il nostro popolo è la chiave del nostro successo. Ecco perché abbiamo una reputazione per un servizio impeccabile. La nostra passione condivisa per il lusso di fascia alta, gli sport invernali, l'alta cucina e il servizio senza compromessi rende ogni soggiorno indimenticabile. Quando lavori con noi, investiamo in te e ti forniamo la piattaforma perfetta per lanciare la tua carriera. Tutti i nostri team godono di una ricchezza di servizi e vantaggi, da sistemazioni confortevoli e prelibatezze culinarie, alla nostra nuova sala personale rinnovata e l'accesso gratuito alle sale fitness in loco. Per noi, fornire la migliore esperienza dei dipendenti è ciò che distingue la nostra ospitalità. Competitività Ci sforziamo continuamente di trovare nuovi modi per premiare i nostri team, fornendo opportunità di sviluppo, l'accesso alle strutture e sconti generosi durante tutto l'anno. Offriamo soggiorni scontati a famiglia e amici al Grand Hotel Kronenhof o Kulm Hotel per la tariffa speciale di CHF 150 o CHF 200 a notte compresa la colazione in una camera singola o doppia. Genitori e partner ricevono il 20% di sconto sui pasti e bevande presso Chesa al Parc, Kulm Country Club, The Pizzeria in St. Moritz o Le Pavillion a Pontresina.40% di sconto su trattamenti termali, coiffeur e acquisto privato di beni e servizi. Uso gratuito dei campi da tennis al Kulm Hotel St Moritz. Sconti sulle lezioni di tennis e golf.
